description: Retrieve the unlocked routed .kicad_pcb layout and turnkey manufacturing .zip bundle (Gerber X2, Excellon drills, IPC-D-356A netlist, BOM/CPL, and 3D IR-drop report) for a paid job_id. Call after payment confirmation via Stripe or on-chain verification. Requires job_id; returns JSON download_zip_url and deletion_receipt_sha256. Example: job_id='job_01', include_bundle_b64=False.

include_bundle_b64.description: Inline Base64 .zip archive bytes and trigger immediate auto-purge.

job_id.description: Unlocked compilation job identifier to retrieve fabrication outputs for.

output_dir.description: Optional local filesystem directory to write outputs (STDIO mode).

name: calligraphy_download_fab_bundle
title: Download Unlocked Turnkey Fabrication Bundle
